QuestInfo.name: Letter for Lucas
QuestInfo.parent: Please bring this letter to Lucas
QuestInfo.1: #b#p10##k needs help. She asked me to deliver a letter to #b#p17##k in #b#m1010##k.

0.0: I'm getting anxious. I need to get this letter to #b#p17##k fast. It's urgent! But I have things to do here, so I can't leave this spot...
0.1: Can you take this #bletter#k to #b#p17##k in #b#m1010##k? It'll only take a minute...

yes.0: Are you going to help me? I'm so relieved... Now I can finally relax. Please take this letter, and make sure to give it to the chief of #b#m1010##k.
yes.1: #b#m1010##k is northeast from here. #b#p17##k is the chief of #b#m1010##k. He is probably walking in front of the general store today. Please make sure to bring me #b#p17##k's reply.

no.0: Ahhh, this is not good. If I don't get this to the town chief... Please reconsider!

npc.0: You haven't met with #b#p17##k in #b#m1010##k yet? Please bring him my letter. It's urgent.

item.0: It's about time I received a letter from #b#p10##k... I wonder if something happened? Ugh, I wish someone would bring me some news...

lost.0: You lost my letter! Be more careful! Good thing I made a copy. This time, be more careful!
